items.title: Moon landing
items.snippet_en: ISRO's Chandrayaan-3 mission's Vikram lander successfully landed near the Moon's south pole on August 23, 2023, at 6:04 PM IST (12:34 GMT). This made India the first country to achieve a soft landing in the Moon's south polar region and the fourth country overall to successfully perform a soft landing on the Moon.

The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) successfully landed its Chandrayaan-3 mission's Vikram lander near the Moon's south pole on August 23, 2023. This made India the first country to achieve a soft landing in the Moon's south polar region. The landing was a historic milestone for India and global space exploration.
